plain_english_policy: This bill is a ceremonial resolution that officially renames a specific segment of Alabama Highway 113 (between Flomaton and Interstate 65) as the 'Dewey J. Bondurant, Jr., Highway' to honor Mayor Dewey J. Bondurant's contributions.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no change in infrastructure funding or physical road conditions; it solely establishes an honorary designation and mandates that officials place markers for this name on the highway segment described.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a resolution to rename a road in honor of Dewey J. Bondurant, Jr., but the text does not support any broader policy positions beyond this specific honorary designation.
evidence_quotes: "NAMING THE PORTION OF ALABAMA HIGHWAY 113 BETWEEN HIGHWAY 29/31 IN FLOMATON AND INTERSTATE 65 THE DEWEY J. BONDURANT, JR. HIGHWAY.",
"WHEREAS... it is with sincere pride and admiration that we name a portion of Alabama Highway 113 between Flomaton and Interstate 65 the Dewey J. Bondurant, Jr., Highway;"
"BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF ALABAMA... That the portion of Alabama Highway 113 between Highway 29/31 in Flomaton and Interstate 65 is hereby named the Dewey J. Bondurant, Jr. Highway"
